Reference / unicode/character

unicode/character#

Unicode Character Database properties for one Unicode scalar value.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let letter = UnicodeCharacter(origin: 'Ж');
letter.name();             // "CYRILLIC CAPITAL LETTER ZHE"
letter.category();         // UnicodeCategory.uppercase_letter
letter.combining_class();  // 0

Description#

Unicode Character Database properties for one Unicode scalar value.

Numeric characters include more than decimal digits:

UnicodeCharacter(origin: '½').numeric_value(); // 0.5

numeric_value() throws NonNumericCharacter when the character has no Unicode Numeric_Value property. name() returns an empty string for unassigned, private-use, control and other characters without a formal Unicode name. Property values are those of Unicode 17.0.0, the version of the grapheme clusters and widths of terminal/width; they do not vary with the operating system or selected backend. A character assigned after 17.0.0 is unassigned here, without a name, even where unicode/normalization (Unicode 18.0.0) already knows it.

name() is string

UnicodeCharacter.combining_class#

Its canonical combining class, 0 for most characters.

Its numeric value, 5.0 for 5 or 0.5 for ½; NonNumericCharacter when it has none.
